messages:
Priya (SE): Hey team — Dana asked for concrete evidence on logging and admin audit trails for the POC. They need how we deliver logs to SIEM, retention windows, and proof of admin action logging.

Alex (AE): tagging @Dana — we promised docs and a short demo flow for SIEM ingest. Dana, are you planning direct syslog ingest or S3-based pickup?

Dana (Customer): Prefer direct syslog over TLS into our Splunk instance, but we can fall back to S3 if needed. Also need retention >= 12 months for admin activity, per compliance.

Priya (SE): Ok. For POC we can do two options:
- Syslog over TLS -> ship logs in near real-time (tcp/6514)
- S3 export (parquet + gz) -> periodic ingestion (every 5-15 min)

Priya (SE): Short example config we can demo (syslog):
```
# rlog-agent.conf
output syslog_tls {
  host = "splunk.company.com"
  port = 6514
  tls = on
  format = "json"
}
```

Priya (SE): For S3 export we put audit/trace events under s3://redwood-poc-exports/<customer-id>/audit/YYYY/MM/DD/*.gz

Marco (CISO): Note the retention and access controls:
- Admin activity (console/API role changes): retention default 2 years, can be reduced to 12 months on request.
- Request traces (token-level logs, query text): 90 days by default, but PII-sensitive prompts can be redacted — we recommend 30 days if customer requires.
- Exports are encrypted at rest (SSE-KMS) and support customer-managed keys.

Marco (CISO): We can provide a short attestation for POC stating where logs live, retention policy, and that admin actions are logged with actor, timestamp, and IP. That attestation can be signed by security@redwood.com.

Alex (AE): I'll coordinate the attestation and sample logs. Can we also include a small sample: 1) admin role change event, 2) service restart event, 3) request trace with masked input? Dana, is that ok for proof?

Dana (Customer): Yes please. Also need to confirm we get continuous JSON schema so Splunk field extraction is easy.

Priya (SE): We'll send a schema and a 10-event sample. Example event fields: event_type, actor, actor_role, timestamp, resource, action, request_id, client_ip, raw_payload (redacted).

sec-bot: Policy link: https://redwood.internal/security/logging-and-retention (access: redwood employees + signed NDA).

Marco (CISO): For the SIG/CAIQ items — logging evidence mapping:
- CAIQ A1.1 -> provide CloudTrail-like audit log samples and S3 export logs
- CAIQ A1.2 -> KMS key usage & rotation notes (we'll attach key IDs and rotation cadence)
- CAIQ A2.5 -> admin activity trail with actor identity and approval metadata (we'll provide redacted sample)

Priya (SE): Action items:
- Alex: prepare attestation PDF + 10-event sample (includes admin change + service event + masked trace). deadline EOD tomorrow.
- Marco: export KMS metadata and short note on retention defaults. deadline +48h.
- Priya: demo config for syslog & S3, and JSON schema. deadline EOD today.

Alex (AE): Noted. Dana — I’ll drop the attestation and sample in the shared drive and ping you when ready. Anything else you need for the POC acceptance criteria?

Dana (Customer): Might also need proof of deletion flow for account termination. Can you show how we purge historic data?

Priya (SE): Yes — we have a deletion job that can remove S3 prefixes and related indices; we can show the CLI run and audit trail showing the deletion request and completed status. Example: `redwood-admin delete-customer-data --customer-id=acme-123 --confirm`. We log the actor and job-id.

Marco (CISO): We'll include the deletion audit sample with job-id and KMS rewrap notes. Also include retention SLA language for enterprise customers.

Alex (AE): I'll consolidate into one ZIP for Dana: attestation.pdf, 10_sample_events.jsonl, schema.json, syslog_example.conf, deletion_audit_sample.json.

Dana (Customer): Great, thanks. Looking forward to the ZIP and a quick 20-min walkthrough tomorrow.

Priya (SE): Scheduling 20m demo now, invite sent. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
